reason: A DSH plugin that automates switching between concurrently running Windows and WSL2 DSH environments through web UI controls and local server start/check operations.

summaries.zh: 通过网页界面在并行运行的 Windows 与 WSL2 DSH 环境之间切换，并在需要时检查或启动目标本地服务。
summaries.en: Switches between concurrently running Windows and WSL2 DSH environments from the web UI while checking or starting the selected local server when needed.

capabilities: Adds web UI controls for switching between Windows and WSL2 DSH instances
Exposes local HTTP endpoints for environment state and switching
Checks and starts local DSH servers using powershell.exe and wsl.exe
Navigates the current browser tab to the selected local environment
